name: AuzixControlPanel
description: First AUZiX-native desktop control hub for hardware, service, package, network, sharing, printer, sound, and proof-run visibility.

panels.label: System health
panels.purpose: Catch missing proc/sys/cgroup mounts, disk pressure, and memory/swap pressure before app tests mislead us.

panels.label: Network status
panels.purpose: Show address, route, DNS, and basic reachability without opening a shell treasure hunt.

panels.label: Network settings
panels.purpose: Expose configured interfaces, default route, DNS intent, and future static/DHCP controls before mutating network state.

panels.label: Packages
panels.purpose: Expose package repo health and installed package receipts from the desktop.

panels.label: Services
panels.purpose: Make AUZiX service state visible before a fuller lua init/service manager lands.

panels.label: Containers
panels.purpose: Show rootful/rootless Podman readiness, networking, and proof containers.

panels.label: Desktop session
panels.purpose: Surface the exact DBus/audio/session gaps that currently block richer GUI app validation.

panels.label: Sound settings
panels.purpose: Show audio devices, PulseAudio/session readiness, SPICE/audio gaps, and user permission issues.

panels.label: Printers
panels.purpose: Make printer service, queue, and socket state visible before enabling add/remove printer actions.

panels.label: File sharing
panels.purpose: Surface SMB/NFS client and server readiness, configured shares, and mounted network filesystems.

commands.name: auzix-control-panel-report
commands.description: Write a JSON support snapshot for BKC/Ollama review.

known_blockers.message: Start as Lua/TUI for fast proof; add EFL frontend after the probe contract settles.
Read-only probes come first. Mutating actions need explicit sudo/polkit rules and receipts.

ollama_prompt: Given a control-panel probe failure, classify whether AUZiX is missing a platform package, a service mount, a user/group permission, a compatibility path, or an app-specific runtime expectation. Propose the smallest package-contract fix and do not suggest manual shell-only fixes.
